# Model authoring + conversion stack. litert-torch is the renamed successor of
# ai-edge-torch; it pulls in ai-edge-litert, ai-edge-quantizer, litert-converter
# and torchao at compatible versions — do not pin those transitively here.
# Resolved versions are recorded in requirements.lock.txt after install.
# cu128 variant: default PyPI torch ships the CUDA 13 runtime, but FASRC GPU
# nodes run a CUDA 12.9 driver (12090) — cu130 wheels can't initialize there.
--extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu128
torch==2.12.0+cu128
litert-torch==0.9.1
numpy>=2.0,<3
h5py>=3.11
scipy
matplotlib
pyyaml
tqdm
